**Company Overview – Global Pacific Perunding Sdn. Bhd. (SYN‑000302)**  

- **Status & Structure**: Active private limited company, incorporated 15 Jan 2014 in Perak.  
- **Industry & Focus**: Professional services – management consulting targeted at SMEs.  
- **Share Capital**: RM 500,000.  

**Key Personnel & Ownership**  
| Role | Name | Appointment Date | Shareholding |
|------|------|-------------------|--------------|
| Managing Director | Director 1 | 15 Apr 2021 | 11.54 % |
| Executive Director | Director 3 | 25 Mar 2018 | 29.76 % |
| Director | Director 2 | 1 May 2024 | 58.70 % |

- The three directors collectively own 100 % of the company, with Director 2 holding the majority stake.  

**Financial & Legal Standing**  
- No financial statements submitted in the data set.  
- No recorded litigation or legal disputes.  

**Vet‑Ready Takeaways**  
- Fully owned and controlled by its three directors, indicating clear governance.  
- Active and compliant (no litigation).  
- Limited public financial data – request recent audited accounts and cash‑flow details before final approval.
